name: product-catalog-maker
description: Turn a product spreadsheet (CSV/XLSX) and a folder of photos into an A4 catalog PDF with a cover, contents, one section per category and searchable text, plus a self-contained editable HTML version. Flags missing photos, prices and duplicate SKUs, and lists added, removed and re-priced products every time you rebuild. Runs locally; no API keys.

description_i18n.en: Turn a product spreadsheet (CSV/XLSX) and a folder of photos into an A4 catalog PDF with a cover, contents, one section per category and searchable text, plus a self-contained editable HTML version. Flags missing photos, prices and duplicate SKUs, and lists added, removed and re-priced products every time you rebuild. Runs locally; no API keys.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 用商品表格（CSV/XLSX）和图片文件夹生成 A4 产品目录 PDF：封面、目录页、按分类分节、文字可搜索；同时生成可在浏览器里修改、打印的网页版。自动检查缺图、缺价格和重复编号；每次重新生成都会列出新增、下架和改价的商品。全部本地处理，无需 API 密钥。

fontPath.title: 中文字体文件（可选）
fontPath.description: 可选。目录文字使用的字体文件（.ttf/.otf/.ttc）完整路径。默认自动查找系统中文字体（macOS: Arial Unicode / 冬青黑体，Windows: 黑体 / 微软雅黑，Linux: Noto Sans CJK）。
